CustomField.description: Rich-text instructions rendered inside the page body, above the page's sections, by the formTemplatePageSection LWC (lightning-formatted-rich-text bound to Details__c). Use it for guidance the respondent reads while filling the page — what to enter, document requirements, eligibility notes. Distinct from Description (the Stages-view card subtitle) and from Page Title / Page Footer. Shows in both the linear and Stages runtimes whenever the page is open. Also surfaced in the FormTemplate_PDF_Controller output. HTML field.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Add rich-text instructions that appear in the page body above the form sections, guiding the respondent as they complete this page. Use it for help text, document requirements, or eligibility notes; unlike Description, this shows on the page itself in both linear and Stages runtimes.
CustomField.label: Details
